_comment: Source (English) bundle for vscode.l10n.t(...) host strings. Keys are the English source strings; the editor uses these verbatim for English and looks up bundle.l10n.<locale>.json for other display languages. Normally auto-extracted by @vscode/l10n-dev; maintained by hand here.
